## Design

### 2026-10-01 — Today I worked on the structural design and component selection for Hexabug, my 6-legged walking robot. I sketched three different chassis configurations and selected a flat rectangular body style to

**9h**

Today I worked on the structural design and component selection for Hexabug, my 6-legged walking robot. I sketched three different chassis configurations and selected a flat rectangular body style to maintain a low center of gravity. This layout provides optimal stability for the micro servos and offers sufficient mounting surface area for the Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W, PCA9685 driver board, power regulators, and battery.

### 2026-10-01 — In this session, I finalized the complete hardware architecture and mechanical layout for the Hexabug 6-legged robot project. I structured the inverse kinematics (IK) calculation model for a 3-DOF leg

**15h**

In this session, I finalized the complete hardware architecture and mechanical layout for the Hexabug 6-legged robot project. I structured the inverse kinematics (IK) calculation model for a 3-DOF leg system, mapping out how the Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W will send I2C commands to the PCA9685 16-channel PWM driver board to execute fluid tripod gaits.

![1000009873](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/AClR0ych12oikn20mz22NKN0Tbh6kTyB/3dccd0d4a193eb164665b0f9fbbaf1e14b88bfdafb85c5349ee0d54d99ddede8.jpg)

![1000009865](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/AClR0ych12oikn20mz22NKN0Tbh6kTyB/fed918b3dea54c59fa0ebcbfacbdb5797e10e113a0b714debcd9ca2b1525ae5b.jpg)

![1000009868](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/AClR0ych12oikn20mz22NKN0Tbh6kTyB/0667a014a60b19d4c85f72d2e3581e9ca984cc694e8d387aa4953c43c2b8f019.jpg)

I also mapped out the power distribution setup, pairing a 7.4V LiPo battery with a high-current step-down buck converter to safely power the 18 SG90 micro servos without causing brownouts on the microcontroller. Lastly, I resolved all project repository configuration checks on GitHub to sync BOM.md and JOURNAL.md with Hack Club.
